description: Delete an UNSENT email draft (email_drafts) you no longer need. Only rows with status 'draft' can be removed — a sent email is a record and is refused. Any temporary download links belonging to the draft go with it. Use this after abandoning a draft, so it does not linger on the lead looking like mail that is still due to go out.

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to delete

name: delete_draft
